function.description: Send a message to the user (status update, question, or information). It goes ONLY to this session's own person: the chat you are in, or in a scheduled/goal run your owner's private chat. It never posts to a room, group or other recipient: use message(surface=..., target=..., text=...) for those.
function.name: send_message

parameters.description: Send a message to the user.

reply_to.description: 044: in a GROUP room, the message id this reply answers (threads the reply to that line). Omit in a 1:1 chat — a live room turn already answers the line that triggered it.

wait_for_response.description: If True, pause and wait for user to respond
